question: To whom and under what test condition must a particular teaching be given rather than withheld?
premises: A particular teaching carries an obligation to be given.
That teaching is to be given to one who has previously accomplished the requisite practice.
That recipient must have been tested for the course of one year.
inference: Transmission is restricted to a previously accomplished person who has passed a one-year test.
uncertainties: The nature of the test is not specified by this verse alone.
plain_english: This teaching is to be given to one who has previously accomplished it and has been tested for one year.
